configuration.tca_refinement: linear projection at fine minimum; apply only |dt| < 60 sec; re-propagate and accept only if range improves

threshold_boundary_tests.below_threshold: covered by synthetic crossings at 0.15/0.25 km targets and threshold 5 km
threshold_boundary_tests.at_threshold: not directly constructible through public screen() because result minRange is data-dependent; production uses strict minRange >= threshold => no detection
threshold_boundary_tests.above_threshold: production uses strict minRange >= threshold => no detection

risk_findings.formula: weighted sum of miss distance 40%, data uncertainty 20%, relative velocity 15%, geometry 15%, freshness 10%; rounded and clamped 0..100

independent_reference.reason: No historical conjunction reference dataset was found in the repository; synthetic cases are not real events.

invalid_input_tests.production_screen_invalid_data: not invoked through screen because malformed OrbitalObject can fail during SGP4 construction; production propagation throws or returns non-finite states, but screen does not explicitly catch propagation failures in coarse/fine passes.
invalid_input_tests.missing_data: not silently converted to a valid conjunction by this harness

warnings: Synthetic scenarios validate controlled mathematics and software behavior only.
No real-world conjunction accuracy claim is supported.
Production screen() does not catch propagation exceptions in its coarse/fine loops; a malformed object can abort the screen call rather than return a structured failure.
